#include <iostream>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    long long R, C;
    cin >> R >> C;
    if (R > C) {
        swap(R, C);
    }

    auto solve = [&](long long r, long long c) -> long long {
        if (r < 3 && c < 3) return 0LL;
        if (r == 1) {
            long long m = c % 6;
            long long res = c;
            if (m != 0) {
                if (m <= 3) res -= m;
                if (m == 4) res -= 2;
                if (m == 5) res -= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }
        if (r == 2) {
            if (c == 3 || c == 7) return 2LL * (c - 1);
            return 2LL * c;
        }
        long long product = r * c;
        if ((product & 1LL) == 0LL) return product;
        return product - 1LL;
    };

    cout << solve(R, C) << endl;
    return 0;
}
